library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet")
groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  dplyr::left_join(markets |> dplyr::select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(outcome_numeric = dplyr::case_when(
    outcome == "YES" ~ 1,
    outcome == "NO" ~ 0
  )) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(substr(resolved_at, 1, 10)) - date),
    time_bucket = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
        days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
        days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
        days_to_resolution > 0 ~ "1 to 7 days",
        days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
      ),
      levels = c("More than 90 days", "30 to 90 days", "7 to 30 days", "1 to 7 days", "Final day"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
final_day <- joined |>
  dplyr::filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

ggplot2::ggplot(final_day, ggplot2::aes(x = probability)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Distribution of final-day forecasts",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )

calibration <- final_day |>
  dplyr::mutate(probability_bin = cut(
    probability,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 90, by = 10), "-", seq(10, 100, by = 10), "%"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE
  )) |>
  dplyr::group_by(probability_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = dplyr::n_distinct(market_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)

calibration <- calibration |>
  dplyr::mutate(predicted_probability = (as.numeric(probability_bin) - 0.5) / 10)

ggplot2::ggplot(calibration, ggplot2::aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate)) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(size = n)) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(name = "Markets per bin") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Final-day forecast calibration by probability bin",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES rate"
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  dplyr::group_by(time_bucket) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(absolute_error),
    snapshots = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(accuracy)

ggplot2::ggplot(accuracy, ggplot2::aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_absolute_error, group = 1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```
